candidate.CE: European baseline: the research model team_form_poisson_v1 exactly as live runs it for UCL and UEL today: Dixon-Coles goal rates and ten-match form from the competition's own European results before the fold origin (uses no odds and no domestic results)

periods_config.backfill: Older UCL (2015/16-2022/23) and UEL (2020/21-2021/22) results in .football_cache/europa/backfill, reconciled by european_backfill.py (OpenFootball and Fixture Download agree, or OpenFootball alone in the labelled single-source UCL seasons 2015/16-2016/17). Harness only: the live loaders are unchanged. Every backfilled match is before the first cached season, so no row on or after 21 Jan 2025 changes.

holdout_choice.below_minimum: No untouched block reaches the domestic 300-match minimum under either reading. The European holdout has its own minimum of 250 fixtures and 6 weeks (european_holdout_review_gates in benchmark_promotion_rules.json), decided on 11 Nov 2026 before any European holdout scoring (the European ledger has no entry); the block itself is unchanged.
holdout_choice.decided_by: Prompt 5 chose the block by the rule "most recent block no earlier benchmark, audit or live report has scored"; Paul approved it on 11 Nov 2026.
holdout_choice.rule: The most recent block no benchmark, written model audit or live report scored, counted as for the domestic holdout: automated in-run pipeline reports (decay tuning, goal-market validation) are not counted, as they also covered the domestic holdout window.
holdout_choice.strict_alternative: Counting the in-run reports too, only 64 UCL matches after the warm-up of the time (to 28 Jan 2025) are untouched (22 Jan - 15 Sep 2025): UCL decay tuning scored from 16 Sep 2025 and UCL goal-market validation from 1 Oct 2025 (cited in docs/audits/2026-10-24-per-market-approval.md).

periods.development: From the end of each competition's warm-up to 30 Jun 2024: UCL 2017/18-2023/24 (backfill to 2022/23, football-data.org 2023/24); UEL 2021/22 from 25 Oct 2021 (backfill) and 2022/23-2023/24 (snapshot). UEL from 22 Feb 2024 was already scored by the 22 Oct 2026 Europa audits.
periods.holdout: UCL only, 21 Jan 2025 - 12 Oct 2026 (unchanged: 288 matches, 29 weeks; the warm-up now ends in 2017, so none is in the warm-up). No benchmark, written model audit or live report scored these results. Locked: never scored or trained on by a locked run; scored only with a declaration, once per candidate and once per frozen setup, recorded in evaluation/european_holdout_ledger.json. Sample minimum: 250 fixtures and 6 weeks (benchmark_promotion_rules.json, european_holdout_review_gates, decided 11 Nov 2026 before any European holdout scoring).
periods.retrospective: UEL from 21 Jan 2025 (scored by the 22 Oct 2026 Europa audits and the pipeline's goal-market validation, live-graded from 22 Oct 2026) and UCL from 13 Oct 2026 (live-graded). Diagnostics only, never release evidence.
periods.validation: 1 Jul 2024 - 20 Jan 2025 (unchanged): UEL, and UCL 2024/25 to 20 Jan. UEL 2024/25 was the Europa research audit's development period: already inspected.
periods.warm_up: Training only, never scored: each competition's results until its 14-day fold has at least 250 earlier matches of that competition (the pipeline's own UCL/UEL walk-forward warm-up). UCL: 2015/16-2016/17 (exactly 250, the two single-source seasons); development from the 4 Sep 2017 fold. UEL: 2020/21 and 2021/22 to 24 Oct 2021; development from the 25 Oct 2021 fold. Checked against the data by evaluation_harness.check_development_start.

domestic_form.note: Domestic form = at least min_matches league matches in the 8 football-data files within the days before the fixture (earlier days only), team names resolved by the reviewed research resolver (team_research.history_team; no fuzzy matching), over the cached seasons and the older domestic files (2015/16-2020/21, European coverage only). Domestic holdout results (16 Jan - 10 Oct 2026, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Super Lig) are left out, so fixtures then involving those clubs count as without form. European holdout fixtures are counted by identity only.
